mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP2041 directly increased inner-membrane permeability in tested Pseudomonas aeruginosa strains as measured by propidium iodide dead-cell staining.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2041 against Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC 27853, PA-H 24, and PA-VET 38

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM evidence supports AMP2041-associated Pseudomonas aeruginosa cell-envelope damage after exposure, including holes, dents, bursts, lysed cells, and debris.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=14:Scanning electron microscopy analysis|xml:sec=19:Scanning electron microscopy analysis|xml:fig=3:Fig. 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM is morphological evidence for envelope disruption; it does not identify an intracellular molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill data support rapid bactericidal activity of AMP2041, with LD90 reached within 20 minutes for the tested clinical isolates at 12.5 μg/ml.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2041 against human and animal Pseudomonas aeruginosa clinical isolates
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is bactericidal kinetics, not a standalone molecular mechanism assignment.
